name: Juan Sebastián Sánchez Urbano
headline: Industrial Automation Engineer · Machine Learning, Technical Sales, Power BI and AI
summary: Industrial Automation Engineer focused on Machine Learning, technical sales and data analysis. Since October 2026 I have been a technical advisor at Industrias CATO, where I advise customers on fastener selection and technical solutions. Previously I worked as a technical and sales advisor at a technical-solutions company, where I analyzed customer information and automated data processes, and as CNC and Robotics area leader I analyzed production and quality-control variables. I build predictive models, Power BI dashboards and AI workflows with Python, R and n8n, and design medallion-architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold) ETL pipelines. I combine industrial engineering with analytics to turn data into sales and production decisions. I maintain a public portfolio with projects, my own tools and automation, data and 3D printing services.

experience.text: I advise customers on fastener selection: threads, heads, materials, finishes and applications, and support the technical validation of their requirements.
experience.achievement: I built technical reference tools available in this portfolio: a fastener academy and a thread calculator.
